title: Design System: Anish Singh — Working Notebook

display.purpose: Hero name only, one letter per paper cutout (Bebas Neue).

headline.purpose: Page titles via PageHead, followed by the self-drawing pen underline.

title.purpose: Project names, log roles, product tags.

body.purpose: Paragraphs on paper and desk, ~34–36rem measure (Spectral).

label.purpose: Buttons, flags, running heads, metadata, Fig. captions (Courier Prime).

hand.purpose: Handwritten notes, form labels, sticky notes, desk clock (Caveat); always slightly rotated.

shadows.name: lift-0
shadows.purpose: Small objects flat on the page (monogram).

shadows.name: lift-2
shadows.purpose: Heavy stacks: legal pad, About spread, cutting mat, toasts.

shadows.name: lift-3
shadows.purpose: Paper picked up: .lift hover/focus-within and modal sheets only.

shadows.name: drop
shadows.purpose: Wrapper shadow for masked or clipped sheets (torn, zigzag, clip-path), which lose their box-shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Reveals, ink drawing, highlighter sweeps, fades.

motion.name: ease-paper
motion.purpose: Paper handling: lift, tape, tabs, letter drop.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: [data-reveal] → [data-inview], set once by RevealObserver; an attribute so React re-renders never wipe it.

motion.name: ink-draw
motion.purpose: Doodles: .draw on reveal, .hero-draw on first paint.

motion.name: hero-letter
motion.purpose: Pure-CSS hero entrance; no hydration wait.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: CSS scroll-driven parallax for background doodles; supported browsers with motion allowed only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations/transitions 0.01ms; reveals shown; strokes and highlights pre-drawn; GSAP pin off; notebook pre-turned, no tilt

components.name: Sticky Button
components.description: Primary action (Resume, Download PDF, Search): a sticky note, slightly rotated, lifts when handled.

narrative.overview:
The site is one physical developer notebook left open on a charcoal desk under a lamp. Every section is a numbered page; every piece of content is a real paper artifact pasted, taped or clipped onto it: printouts on tractor-feed paper, thermal receipts, graph sheets, blueprints, kraft tags, sticky notes, a yellow legal pad. The desk is dark and quiet; the paper carries all the colour and all the reading.

Depth is physical, never digital. Paper rests on the desk with a contact shadow, sits a degree or two off square, and lifts toward the reader when handled. Marks on the paper are made by three inks with distinct jobs, plus a graphite pencil, and they ink themselves in as the page arrives. Motion is the motion of paper and pen: sheets settle, stamps slam, strokes draw, highlighter sweeps. Nothing glows, nothing is a pill, nothing is a rounded SaaS card.

The one three-dimensional object is the notebook itself, on the last page, turning to "one last page." It is a finale, not a pattern.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal desk with fibre grain and a lamp-light pool; every readable surface is a paper stock.
Square-cut paper, small per-sheet rotations, soft two-part desk shadows (lift tokens).
Three inks with fixed roles: marker yellow, pen magenta, cobalt.
Four faces, four jobs: Bebas display, Spectral body, Courier Prime typed labels, Caveat handwriting.
Page furniture everywhere: running heads, index flags, page numbers, Fig. captions.
Scroll reveals via a data attribute; hand-drawn SVG doodles that draw themselves; full reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Yellow highlights and calls to action; magenta edits, stamps, focuses and links; cobalt draws technical and AI material. Don't swap roles, and don't add a fourth ink.

rules.name: The Paper Carries Colour Rule
rules.body: The desk stays charcoal. Colour comes from paper stocks, flags and ink marks laid on it. The only full-bleed colour fields are the three chapter dividers.

rules.name: The Deep Pen Rule
rules.body: Magenta text smaller than display size on a light stock uses `pen-deep`.

rules.name: The Four Jobs Rule
rules.body: Bebas is cut out or stamped, Spectral is read, Courier is printed or filed, Caveat is handwritten. Pick the face by how the mark would be made.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker text above headlines. A page opens with its running head (notebook title on the left, index flag with page number on the right), then the title. Catalog numbers sit under the work as figure captions.

rules.name: The Fig. Numbering Rule
rules.body: Figures are captioned in Courier as `Fig. <page>.<n> — description`, where `<page>` is the two-digit page number from the registry (Fig. 03.1 on page 03, Fig. 05.1–05.4 on page 05). Captions go below the figure, never above its title.

rules.name: The Drop Wrapper Rule
rules.body: A mask or clip-path (`.torn-top`, `.torn-bottom`, `.zigzag`, clip-path tags) cuts off the element's own box-shadow. Masked sheets therefore sit inside a `.drop` wrapper that casts a filter shadow. `.drop.lift` hover swaps to the deeper filter.

rules.name: The Handled Paper Rule
rules.body: `.lift` is the only hover elevation: the sheet rises 6px, turns by `--rh` (default +1.2°) and moves to lift 3, over 0.45s on `--ease-paper`. Tape on it lifts with it. It only runs on hover-capable devices, and `:focus-within` triggers it too.

dos: Do put every readable block on a named paper stock, chosen by what the artifact would be in real life.
Do give every sheet its own `--r` rotation (usually within ±3°) and alternate direction with neighbours.
Do use `--lift-1` for resting paper, `--lift-2` for heavy stacks, and let only `.lift` hover reach `--lift-3`.
Do wrap masked or clipped sheets (torn, zigzag, clip-path) in `.drop`.
Do open each page with the running head and its registry flag, and caption figures as `Fig. <page>.<n> — …` below the work.
Do reveal with `data-reveal` and stagger with `--d`. Put `pathLength="1"` on every drawable path.
Do keep yellow for highlight and action, magenta for editing, stamps, focus and links, and cobalt for technical and AI drawings.
Do use `pen-deep` for small magenta text on light paper.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and the dashed pen focus outline visible.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, pill badges, glows, gradients on text, or dark SaaS panels. Round corners only on objects that are round in life (the mat, a clip).
Don't add kicker or eyebrow labels above headlines. The running head and Fig. captions do that job.
Don't use hard offset (neobrutalist) shadows. Depth is contact shadow plus soft cast shadow.
Don't tear an edge that wasn't torn. Torn, zigzag and perforated edges belong to specific stocks.
Don't reveal with a runtime-added class. React will strip it, so use the data attribute.
Don't add a fourth ink colour or swap the roles of the three.
Don't add another WebGL scene, or load three.js on mobile or before the last page approaches.
Don't make the hero entrance wait on hydration or JS.
